lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ ርእያ እያ’ሞ ዓይነይ /2/
ከመስግን’የ ጌና /2/ ምሉእ ዘመነይ
[[/chorus]]

ጥበብ ናይ ዓለም ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ
ኵሉ ሰሓበኒ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ሰይጣን ልበይ ኣትዩ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ምስ ኣሰነፈኒ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ቤትካ’ውን ገዲፈ ከም ናይ ዴማስ ከድኩ
ናብ ባሕሪ እዛ ዓለም ድሕሪት ተመለስኩ

ኣብኣ ምስ ኣተኹ ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ
ኣብ ባሕሪ እዛ ዓለም [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ንኹላ ዞርኩዋ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ንድሕሪት ንቕድም [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ሽዑ ተታሓዝኩ ብታኼላ ኃጢኣት
ምውጽኡ ሰኢነ ጀመርኩ’ውን ንብዓት

ፈተውተይ ኩላቶም ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ
ኣብ ቅድመይ ደው በሉ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ኣብ ክንዲ ሓገዞም [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ብኣይ ከሽካዕልሉ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
መኣዲ ተኸሉ ሕሜት’ውን ኣብ ቅድመይ
ብዓለባ ሕሜት ገነዙ ንነፍሰይ

ካብ ዓዘቕቲ ኃጢኣት ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ
ወድ ሰብ መሲልካ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ጐይታይ ኣውጻእካኒ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ብናይ ምሕረት ኢድካ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ ርእያ እያ’ሞ ዓይነይ
ከመስግን’የ ጌና ንምሉእ ዘመነይ

ካባይ ካብ ረሓቐ ናይ ምድሓንካ ጥበብ
ኵሉ ግብሪ ጸልማት [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ብርሃን ካብ ለበስኩ [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ነጺሀ ካብ ኃጢኣት [[highlight]]ምድሓንካ ጥበብ[[/highlight]]
ዓለም ምስ ፍትወታ ደጊም ኣይምነን’የ
ካብኣ’ኳ ዝበልጽ ንዓኻ ሒዘ’የ
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Nay midhanka t'ibeb riʾiya ʾiya’mo ʿayney /2/
Kemesgin’ye gena /2/ miluʾi zemeney
[[/chorus]]

T'ibeb nay ʿalem nay midhanka t'ibeb
Kulu sehabeni [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Seyt'an libey ʾatyu [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Mis ʾasenefeni [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Betka’win gedife kem nay demas kedku
Nab bahri ʾiza ʿalem dihrit temelesku

ʾAbʾa mis ʾatekhu nay midhanka t'ibeb
ʾAb bahri ʾiza ʿalem [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Nikhula zorkuwa [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Nidhirit niqhdim [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Shiʿu tetahazku bitakhela hat'iʾat
Miwtsiʾu seʾine jemerku’win nibʿat

Fetewtey kulatom nay midhanka t'ibeb
ʾAb qidmey dew belu [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
ʾAb kindi hagezom [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Biʾay keshkaʿillu [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Meʾadi tekhelu himet’win ʾab qidmey
Biʿaleba himet genezu ninefsey

Kab ʿazeqhti hat'iʾat nay midhanka t'ibeb
Wed seb mesilka [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Goytay ʾawtsaʾikani [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Binay mihret ʾidka [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Nay midhanka t'ibeb riʾiya ʾiya’mo ʿayney
Kemesgin’ye gena nimluʾi zemeney

Kabay kab rehaqhe nay midhanka t'ibeb
Kulu gibri tselmat [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Birhan kab lebesku [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
Netsiha kab hat'iʾat [[highlight]]midhanka t'ibeb[[/highlight]]
ʿAlem mis fitweta degim ʾayminen’ye
Kabʾa’kwa zibelts niʿakha hize’ye
